summary: The ADB watchdog asks the immune gate to arm Wireless Debugging only when the readiness reason is armable (Wireless Debugging disabled); with Wi-Fi off it stays in standby without a model call or an incident.
reason: S24 26/10: with Wi-Fi off, readiness was standby/wifi_disabled_recovery_standby. readiness_arm_primary called the immune gate before the effect refused that reason, so each attempt spent model calls and opened incidents a3e972e2 and bab3ce34, escalated to the owner, that no repair could close.
